data.body: Reproduction at origin/main 2e85d8558a4 (worktree fix-finwhale-paths, tests/interfaces/store/test_write_after_reclaim_other_paths.py; real bare origin; parentless baseline whose lineage names the clone's epoch published and fetched; read-path throttle marker stamped as just-run). 5 fail: (1) rebar delete exits 1 with 'ticket write refused ... DIVERGED'; (2) rebar.import_tickets raises SupersededStoreRefused at the first flush; (3) a guarded reconciler pass whose reconcile step writes one inbound event writes nothing (_write_event_file raises the refusal); (4) freshness.assert_gate_store_fresh raises 'the completion close gate refused to certify ... DIVERGED'; (5) attest_gate.claim_gate_check returns verdict stale-store. Passing on main as expected: unrelated-remote refusals for delete, reconciler and the close gate, plus the failed-fetch and busy-lock heal-failure tests (they guard the landed heal). Review-plan run 1 blocked only on P4 (description 8495 > 8000 chars); this narrative moved here from the Cause section, AC unchanged.
